description: LTS Network Entry Capacity Map - East of England (26-27) is a dataset listed in Cadent Gas open data portal, an open data portal of a gas distribution network operator, published or maintained by Cadent Gas Ltd. This dataset presents a static map providing an indicative, high-level view of LTS network entry capacity in the East of England distribution zone at the time of publication. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Future Energy, Shared. The portal shows 2026-03-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-cadent-open-data-portal.
